workarounds.note: the walk level keeps span: 'page' in a one-column guide: kept in the column, the opener band and the cover's tiles would be cut at the top margin, 18 mm from the edge, instead of reaching the trim
the cover style inherits span: 'page' from the level, the only path that honours the \\ break in '# Lisbon \\ on Foot'; in the column the title wraps as 'Lisbon on / Foot'

the chips are ink on paper with a muted outline: a walk's palette does not reach chips, so a chip linked to 'band' or 'wash' would keep the tile-blue base values on every walk's pages (gotcha section-palette-skips-chips)
col() writes each colour's hex beside its paletteId: a heading style's palette follows the id, but the document palette never reaches design elements in 1.4.1
the walk level states breakBefore: { enabled: true, parity: 'odd' }, since a headings object drops the documented level-1 break
the intro style sets breakBefore: { enabled: false }: it would inherit the walk level's odd-page break and leave page 2 blank
the text is ragged, so it is never hyphenated; the recipe sets no locale and claims no hyphenation
ragged paragraphs get no runt control: the last line of every paragraph, box and caption was checked by hand in both editions, and paragraphs that ended on one short word were reworded
the cover's centred, tracked kicker is placed 0.35 mm right of the plaque's edge, half its 2 pt tracking, which centred text counts after the last letter

what.en: The tiles, the map of the routes and its pins, drawn in code
what.es: Los azulejos, el plano de las rutas y sus pines, dibujados en código
